CommunityApplications.Profile:
highsea finds, downloads and organises your films, with their subtitles, and serves them to your own apps: one self-hosted server in place of Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent and Bazarr. It's open source, under the AGPL-3.0.
There are two templates. **highsea** is for Intel or AMD graphics, or none. **highsea-nvidia** is for NVIDIA graphics, with the Nvidia-Driver plugin. Install one of them.
The guides are at https://docs.highsea.tv/install/unraid/. Questions and bugs go to https://github.com/highsea-tv/highsea-tv/issues.
